craft_notes: Sthāyin: guard-asked (voided-mind's all). Rows: row 2 (all→falling?). Close: striving (āyāsa as landing: effort-formed). Rejected: 'protect me from evil' generic — kept falling (apāya precise: the fall); splitting the compound — kept whole (the all-born as one breath).

lines: From the all born of play-arisen, voided-mind, body-and-all I-making —
keep me from falling, supreme goddess, self-knowing-formed through striving.

reads_against.argmap: What protects from falling? → Protection-begging from the all born of delusion-play: effort-born self-awareness as the guard against falling.
